tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the EffectHub catalog of AI tools by product name, job to be done ("transcribe interviews") or category ("video editing"). Optionally narrow by task slug, category slug or pricing model. Returns published, live tools with pricing, Effect score and a link to each card on effecthub.net.

query.description: What to look for: a product name, a job, or a category in plain words.

task.description: Optional task slug, as in https://effecthub.net/ai-for/{task} (e.g. "text-to-speech"). Only tools tagged with it are returned.

category.description: Optional category slug, as in https://effecthub.net/ai-tools/{slug}. A top-level category includes its subcategories; matched on each tool's primary category.

pricing.description: Optional pricing model: free, freemium, free_trial, paid or contact (sales-quoted).

limit.description: How many tools to return (1-20, default 10).

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Everything public on one EffectHub tool card: what it does, category, pricing model and entry price, Effect score, Trust score, platforms, whether it is still alive and when that was last checked, and the card URL. Takes the tool's slug (from search_tools, or the last part of https://effecthub.net/ai/{slug}).

tools.name: list_alternatives
tools.description: Tools that do the same job as the given one. Alternatives our research named for this tool come first (basis "researched"), then live tools from the same category (basis "category"). Discontinued tools are left out.

slug.description: The tool to find alternatives for.

limit.description: How many tools to return (1-20, default 10).

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Two EffectHub tool cards side by side — pricing, scores, platforms, API, liveness — plus the differences in plain sentences. When EffectHub has a researched head-to-head page for the pair, comparison_url links to it.
